facts.text: Melanie ran a charity race for mental health on Saturday, 25 May 2023.

facts.text: Melanie found the charity race to be a rewarding experience that made her think about taking care of her mind.

evidence.quote: I ran a charity race for mental health last Saturday – it was really rewarding. Really made me think about taking care of our minds.

facts.text: Melanie is starting to realize that self-care is important and that taking care of herself helps her better care for her family.

evidence.quote: I'm starting to realize that self-care is really important. It's a journey for me, but when I look after myself, I'm able to better look after my family.

facts.text: Melanie is carving out time each day for self-care activities such as running, reading, and playing her violin.

evidence.quote: I'm carving out some me-time each day - running, reading, or playing my violin - which refreshes me and helps me stay present for my fam!
